excerpt: Agent Jesse is a sales prospecting tool from Floworks that searches the live web for companies and people matching a plain-English description, instead of a stored contact database. Free plan with 1,000 credits; paid plans from $9 a month. Pricing, alternatives and launch feedback.
content:
Agent Jesse is a prospecting tool for sales and marketing teams. Instead of filtering a stored contact database, you describe the buyers you want in plain English, such as companies that just opened a new facility or hired a new head of sales, and Jesse searches public web sources at the time you run the query. It returns matching companies with the source and a short rationale, can find decision-makers at those companies, and can add verified emails and phone numbers for credits. It also offers lookalike searches based on a list that worked for you, and daily lead alerts.

Jesse is built by Floworks Technologies, Inc., which also makes Alisha, an AI email SDR. The free plan includes 1,000 credits, live people and company search, saved lists and one daily alert. Paid plans run from $9 to $100 a month and add more credits, CSV export, lookalikes and enrichment; the Business plan adds API, MCP server and n8n access. CRM integrations such as HubSpot and Salesforce are listed as coming soon, with CSV export available now.

Jesse launched on Product Hunt on 18 June 2026 and finished #3 for the day, with 428 upvotes and 97 comments. Floworks co-founders Sudipta Biswas and Sarthak Shrivastava and CTO Ritesh Kumar answered questions in the thread.

We have not tested Agent Jesse ourselves. This page brings together its official site, pricing and about pages, its Product Hunt page and launch discussion, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.summary_short: Searches the live web for B2B leads described in plain English, instead of a stored database

paragraphs: Sudipta Biswas, co-founder of Floworks, writes that his first startup failed because the team could not crack sales, and that building lead lists stayed painful at Floworks too: by the time a list was ready, many people had changed roles and the signals were out of date.

He pitched Jesse as a search engine for finding your next customers: it searches the live web on every query rather than reselling a database scraped once. You describe the buyer in plain English and Jesse suggests which signals to look for. According to him, more than 1,200 teams had signed up by launch day, and he asked founders and sales leaders for feedback.
launch_story.attribution: Sudipta Biswas, co-founder, on Product Hunt

use_cases: Finding companies that show a buying trigger, such as a new sales leader, a funding round or a new facility
Finding the decision-makers inside a list of target accounts
Building a lookalike list from customers or searches that already worked
Getting a daily alert with fresh leads for a saved search
Feeding leads into your own tools through the API, MCP server or n8n

fit: sell to niche or event-driven segments that stored databases cover poorly
want to describe your ideal buyer in a sentence instead of building filter stacks
want a free plan to try live-web prospecting before paying
not_fit: need native CRM sync today: HubSpot, Salesforce and other integrations are listed as coming soon
need prospects who leave little public trace online, since results depend on what has been published
want to verify every result before spending credits: launch commenters asked for more visible sources and names in the free trial

pricing.intro: Agent Jesse has a free plan and three monthly paid plans, priced in US dollars on its own pricing page. Annual billing is advertised as saving 22%.

plans.name: Free
plans.detail: 1,000 credits, people and company search, saved lists, 1 alert per day

plans.name: Pro
plans.detail: 1,000 credits a month, 3 alerts a day, CSV export, lookalike searches, email and phone enrichment

plans.name: Business
plans.detail: 8,000 credits a month, plus MCP server, n8n and API access

plans.name: Max
plans.detail: 30,000 credits a month and priority support

notes: Credit costs on the pricing page: a search is 10 credits, an email 5 credits and a phone number 30 credits (email included).
Custom plans are available on request.

alternatives.intro: Product Hunt lists Apollo.io, Jeeva AI and Clearbit among Jesse's alternatives. Review scores are Product Hunt users' own; check each tool's pricing page for current prices.

items.name: Apollo.io
items.what: Sales platform with a large B2B contact database, filters and outreach sequences
items.difference: Filter-based search over a stored database plus built-in sequencing, where Jesse runs a fresh web search per query.

items.name: Jeeva AI
items.what: Agentic AI sales assistant for prospecting and outreach
items.difference: Covers outreach as well as prospecting; Jesse focuses on finding and enriching leads and leaves outreach to other tools.

items.name: Clearbit
items.what: B2B data and enrichment for sales and marketing
items.difference: Enriches records you already have from its own data; Jesse discovers new accounts from public web signals.

alternatives.more: Product Hunt also lists Success.ai and ZELIQ.

liked: Plain-English search built around buying signals rather than static filters
Smaller, more relevant lists that allow deeper personalisation
asked: What 'live internet' means in practice (the team says it researches public sources at query time, so results are limited to what has been published)
Whether there is an n8n or MCP integration (yes, both, plus an API)
criticised: The free trial reported contacts found but did not show names, which made results hard to verify
A search for SMBs returned much larger companies
Confusion between the Jesse and Floworks names

quotes.text: I'm curious what "live internet" actually means in practice for sales data specifically.

pros: Searches public web sources at query time rather than a stored database
Plain-English prompts, with a prompt library of signal-based searches
Free plan with 1,000 credits and no card required
API, MCP server and n8n access on the $29 Business plan
cons: CRM and outreach integrations were still listed as coming soon
Results depend on what has been made public online
Credits run down quickly with enrichment: a phone number costs 30 credits
Launch commenters wanted clearer sources and visible names to check results

quotes.author: Florent Berrez
quotes.text: Asked whether Jesse pulls from public sources in real time or from a database refreshed on a schedule.
quotes.reply: Ritesh Kumar replied that searches run live research over public sources at query time, so freshness is limited only by what has been published.

quotes.author: Siddharth Mathur
quotes.text: Asked for names and sources in the free trial so results can be checked.
quotes.reply: Sarthak Shrivastava said an update would show named people, roles, company names and source links.

faq.a: A prospecting tool from Floworks that searches public web sources for companies and people matching a plain-English description of your ideal buyer, then enriches them with emails and phone numbers.
There is a free plan with 1,000 credits, live search, saved lists and one daily alert. Paid plans are $9, $29 and $100 a month.
The team says each search researches public sources when you run it, rather than reading a stored snapshot. Anything not yet published online will not appear.

faq.q: Does it integrate with my CRM?
faq.a: CSV export, an API, an MCP server and n8n are available (API, MCP and n8n on the Business plan). HubSpot, Salesforce, Instantly and others are listed as coming soon.
According to the pricing page, a search costs 10 credits, an email 5 credits and a phone number 30 credits, with the email included.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Agent Jesse?
faq.a: Product Hunt lists Apollo.io, Jeeva AI, Clearbit, Success.ai and ZELIQ. Apollo and Clearbit rely on stored data; Jeeva AI also handles outreach.
